title.zh: 遗产税（已故者 Chew Chee Thong 的遗产）（减免）命令 2008
title.en: Estate Duty (Chew Chee Thong, Deceased) (Remission) Order 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Estate Duty (Chew Chee Thong, Deceased) (Remission) Order 2008.

2. The sum of $896,397.61 payable under the Act on the Estate of Chew Chee Thong, Deceased, being 50% of the interest on the unpaid estate duty from 8th November 1994 to 31st December 2007, is hereby remitted.
